name: Dread
body:
School necromancy [emotion]; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, mesmerist 3, shaman 3, spiritualist 3, warpriest 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Your magic imposes a lingering sense of dread in the target creature, shattering the willpower of even the most willful of foes. If the target fails their saving throw, they any immunity to fear effects they possess as well as any bonuses to saving throws against fear effects they possess for the duration of this spell. If the target is also immune to mind-affecting effects, this benefit does not apply to fear effects while affected by this spell.
